items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Out again in Week 7
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that Love (ankle) won't play Sunday against the Broncos, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Remains uncertain for Sunday
items.text:
Jackson (ankle) remains uncertain for Sunday's game against the Bengals after Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Friday that the quarterback's availability is still being evaluated, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brian Robinson: Won't play in Week 7
items.text:
Robinson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rashee Rice: Not spotted at practice Friday
items.text:
Rice (hamstring/knee) was not present during the portion of Friday's practice open to the media, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

items.title: Bucky Irving: Avoids injury designation
items.text:
Irving (illness) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Carolina, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
